name: scrapy-awesome
description: Scrape any site with your Claude subscription: builds a recipe in the local scrapy-awesome app, validates it, runs the crawl and exports CSV/JSON/XLSX.
long_description: Local-first web scraper on Scrapy (stealth HTTP/Chrome + Playwright). Claude Desktop drives the app's tools through this MCP server: fetch a page, test selectors, save + validate a recipe, run, watch results in the app, export. Human-in-the-loop element picker (request_pick). Requires the scrapy-awesome desktop app (or a `scrapy-awesome` install) — set the binary path below.
